jobs.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: clean background plate for the visual novel 未抵达的心意, Act 2. Keep the lower 24 percent visually quiet for a dialogue box, with important setting details above it. No readable text, logos, watermarks, UI, collage or inset panels. Reference image 1 is STYLE AND SAME-CAMPUS MATERIAL reference only, not the room to copy. A neglected high-school film club activity room after school. Eye-level wide shot from doorway, left wall tall metal-framed windows, rear right closed grey door, rear centre old wooden worktable, right wall glass-front equipment cabinet with indistinct unbranded storage cases and a small old camcorder inside. A couple of empty wooden chairs sit around the worktable; foreground floor centre clear for actors and a separately animated tripod. Several faded wordless abstract film posters on the rear wall. Thin dust on furniture, a few loosely stacked papers at the table edge, sparse dust motes in soft late-afternoon light from upper left. Neglected but safe and usable, no ruined building, no extravagant film studio, no tripod across the foreground.

jobs.label: GPT · 制服平静
jobs.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE full-body transparent PNG sprite for anime visual novel 未抵达的心意 Act 2. Reference 1 defines GPT identity: long flowing white-lilac hair and ahoge, lilac eyes, pale scaled dragon horns, pointed ears, interwoven black-white knot hairpin with tassel on HER LEFT / VIEWER RIGHT, pale dragon wings, long white scaled tail. References 2 and 3 define the existing same-school uniform and clean softly painted anime style. Dress GPT in navy blazer with two brass buttons and fine gold piping, ivory collared blouse, small pale lavender neck ribbon, knee-length navy gold-hem pleated skirt, white calf socks, navy loafers. Modest ordinary school clothing. Stand slightly three-quarter facing viewer, gentle calm attentive expression, hands naturally together. Keep full horns, wings compactly behind body, tail and shoes within portrait 2:3 canvas with margins. Soft upper-left light. No dress, glasses, mascot, text, logo, book or furniture. Genuine transparent background: ALL pixels outside silhouette must be alpha=0 except edge antialiasing; NO colored glow, halo, haze, shadow, gradient or checkerboard, even if reference has one.
